- 出错会怎样：只影响提示和文档措辞，不改任何接受或拒绝的范围，直接撤回即可。

## What changes

Text only. No accepted value, key, answer or code path moves; two refusal messages change words.

### #35409 — summary `dynamic` currency (spec, ui/fields)

The doors admit a `dynamic` summary over any child `currency` field in `dynamic` mode (`isTenantCurrencyAmount`, `packages/spec/src/data/record-currency-path.ts:229-232`; read by `stack.zod.ts:5033` and `objectql/src/record-currency-aggregate-door.ts:87`).

- N2: module header says "three predicates" (`isRecordCurrencyCodeField` :50, `storedHomeAmountSourceOf` :207, `isTenantCurrencyAmount` :229).
- N3: the (d) fallback arm now names what a `currency` child lacks (`record-currency-path.ts:265-270`, used at :282): `fixed` with no `defaultCurrency` code, or a `currencyMode` outside `dynamic` / `fixed` / `record`. A non-`currency` child keeps its old words ("is a 'number' field, …"), so the existing pins in `record-currency-guards.test.ts:1229-1230,1328` and `currency-summary-home-rollup.test.ts:181,203` are unchanged and green. One new case pins the two new arms by subject.
- N4: upgrade-guide entry `18.summary-dynamic-currency-rollup-home-amount-judged-as-served.ts` states the admitted set (surface, replacement, reason). Its `reason` keeps the present-tense rule ("Both doors now admit it only there") apart from the history: before the entry, `defineStack` judged it (then admitting a stored home amount alone) and the engine registry judged only `record` roll-ups. Its acceptance step now saves over "a child field that is not a `currency` field in `dynamic` mode (a `fixed` EUR amount, a plain number or a formula)". The comments in `ui/packages/fields/src/currency.ts`, `index.tsx` and `widgets/SummaryField.tsx` say the same.
- Skills text is out of scope (governed; seat 5 files it).

### #34611 — analytics filter-normalizer comments and `dashboards.mdx`

- N1: the `const` arm JSDoc and the `collectFilterLeaves` comment in `filter-normalizer.ts` now give the full reason. `lowerFilterCondition` (`packages/spec/src/data/filter-lowering.ts:445-470`) wraps every `$nin` outside a `$not` in the NULL escape (`nullEscape`, :435), whose `notSet` leaf names the member. Inside a `$not` it takes that escape when a row with no value satisfies every operator of the spec, and otherwise a `$null: false` requirement, either as its own conjunct or the enclosing one (`requiredFields`, :182). `$null: false` normalizes to a `set` leaf (`filter-normalizer.ts:1214`). Measured on the built spec at this head: `{$not:{f:{$nin:[],$gt:5}}}` lowers to `{$not:{$and:[{f:{$null:false}},{f:{$nin:[],$gt:5}}]}}`.
- N2: left as it is. The `#34514` changeset has been released: its sentence is in `packages/services/service-analytics/CHANGELOG.md:126`, and the changeset file is gone from `.changeset/`. The card's own rule applies ("otherwise fix the docs only").
- D1: the 1,000-record bullet in `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` now says a single-valued relation "usually" runs as a subquery, and names the id-read cases that `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx:703-732` lists, a multi-valued relation (on every driver) first. It also had a MongoDB clause that disagreed with both `query-syntax.mdx:709-714` and the code. On a read verb (`aggregate` included, `relation-filter-lowering.ts:356`), a single-valued relation condition on a driver without `readableIdsLeaf` (MongoDB, OData) is refused before any read (`relationReadDriverRefusal`, :370). It is not id-read under the cap. The bullet now says so, in the capability's terms: "a driver that cannot run it in one read".

### #35522 — temporal-comparand door prose (objectql, core, lint, spec)

The rule, per kind, is `PLACEHOLDER_AT_THE_TEMPORAL_RULE` in `packages/core/src/utils/temporal-comparand.ts:292-298`, applied at :364-365:

- a date macro is stepped around, then judged by its year once resolved;
- a period key and a context token are judged as written;
- an unknown or record-context token is left to the resolver.

Each named sentence now states that rule:

- `temporal-comparand-door.ts`: the module Scope note and the resolved-token section.
- `engine-top-level.ts`: the one comment above `assertTemporalComparandsInterpretable`.
- `engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts`: the per-aggregation comment from comment 7013425050, plus the same sentence on `having` in that file.
- `core/src/utils/import-coerce.ts`: the `readTimeOfDayCell` note. Every placeholder is refused there first, by `classifyFilterToken` (:361).
- `spec/src/data/filter-number-comparand-declared-type.ts`: the tokens section. The resolved forms now include the period key's ISO week key (`filter-tokens.ts`, the period-key resolver).
- `lint/src/validate-rls-predicate-enforceability.ts`: which code a placeholder gets with no caller. The card names it under `packages/objectql/src/validation/`, but the file lives at `packages/lint/src/`. On a temporal field a period key or a context token answers `INVALID_FILTER` from the door. On a number or a boolean field every placeholder does: the number door (`filter-number-comparand-declared-type.ts:351`) and its boolean arm (`filter-boolean-comparand-declared-type.ts:234`, wired under the number door in `engine-top-level.ts`). Otherwise the resolver decides (`filter-tokens.ts:491-528`).
- N4: the junk-literal consequence (`temporal-comparand-door.ts:748-750`) now reads "As written it would reach the driver and be compared as text: it may select every row, none or the wrong ones (or raise a database error), an answer indistinguishable from a real one." Neither "every row or none" nor "a 200" is exact: on a `date` field a partial day such as `'2026-06'` selects a subset, and PostgreSQL raises a database error for text on a `date` column (the measurement at :144). The `having` twin (:827-830) says the same of the groups: "As written it would be compared with each group as text: it may keep every group, none or the wrong ones (or raise a database error), an answer indistinguishable from a real one." The comments that quoted the old phrase (module note, `MisreadClass` doc, year-class comment) are updated. The two `not.toContain` pins in `engine-temporal-comparand-door.test.ts` and `engine-temporal-year-range.test.ts` now name the new phrase, so they are not vacuous. A positive pin on the junk cells (`engine-temporal-comparand-door.test.ts`, the card's comparands test) holds them to it.
- N6: see DELIBERATE CORRECTION below.

### DELIBERATE CORRECTION — `.changeset/35394-context-token-temporal-door.md`

This changeset is pending (it is still in `.changeset/`). Its analytics read-scope bullet now reads: "a scope that compares a `date`, `datetime` or `time` field with a context placeholder is now refused at compile". The predicate judges a context token as written on all three kinds (`temporal-comparand.ts:292-298`), and the same changeset's own BREAKING line already names all three. `check-empty-changeset` is red for this note by design. The confirming record is the dispatching seat's (landing-operations.md).

### Changeset

`.changeset/t1-stale-prose.md` bumps `patch` for `@objectstack/spec`, `objectql`, `core`, `lint`, `service-analytics` and `@object-ui/fields`. It carries the two declaration lines.
